::: {.tool}
### popEVE
[Proteome-wide variant scores]{.what}

Calibrated deleteriousness scores for every possible missense variant in the human proteome, combining evolutionary and population data. Designed to compare variants across genes, which makes it useful for discovering new disease genes and for interpreting cases without parental sequencing.

::: {.link-row}
[Browse scores](https://pop.evemodel.org) [Code](https://github.com/DiasFrazerGroup/popEVE) [Paper](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41588-025-02400-1)
:::

:::

::: {.tool}
### EVE
[Evolutionary model of variant effect]{.what}

An unsupervised deep generative model trained on sequence alignments across species, which classifies human disease variants without being trained on clinical labels.

::: {.link-row}
[Website](https://evemodel.org) [Code](https://github.com/OATML-Markslab/EVE) [Paper](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41586-021-04043-8)
:::
:::

::: {.tool}
### Blend and Disentangle
[Protein stability and "dark energy"]{.what}

Blends a physics-based energy model (AWSEM) with a learned inverse-folding model (PottsMPNN) into one calibrated prediction of how mutations change folding stability, then separates each mutation's evolutionary cost into a stability part and a "dark energy" part that captures functional constraints beyond folding. Runs from a UniProt ID; MIT licence.

::: {.link-row}
[Code](https://github.com/DiasFrazerGroup/blend_and_disentangle) [Data](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21241135) [Summary](papers/2026-blending/index.qmd){.internal} [Preprint](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.07.30.741764)
:::
:::

::: {.tool}
### LFB
[Likelihood-Fitness Bridging]{.what}

Improves variant effect predictions from protein language models (ESM, ProGen) and genome language models (Evo 2) without retraining, by averaging a model's scores across related sequences that evolved under similar pressures. Works with any Hugging Face ESM-style model; MIT licence.

::: {.link-row}
[Code](https://github.com/DiasFrazerGroup/lfb) [Summary](papers/2025-likelihood-to-fitness/index.qmd){.internal} [Paper](https://doi.org/10.52202/085713-4359)
:::
:::

::: {.tool}
### AlphaGenome splicing fine-tuning
[Splicing heads for AlphaGenome]{.what}

Pipelines and code to fine-tune AlphaGenome's splice site, splice site usage and splice junction heads on new RNA-seq data, in PyTorch, with linear probing or LoRA. The splicing heads are being merged into the community package alphagenome-pytorch.

::: {.link-row}
[Code](https://github.com/MiqG/alphagenome_finetuning_rna/tree/v1.0.2) [Blog post](https://genomicsxai.github.io/blogs/2026-009/) [Summary](papers/2026-alphagenome-splicing/index.qmd){.internal}
:::
:::
